area_m2.note: 5 cm² absorber area from the shelf-label design target; not an Exeger orderable cell geometry. Linear scaling of absorber area is an engineering approximation.

states_lux.indoor.note: 200 lux scenario from the application discussion. Set lighting states and timed events to match the installation.

states_lux.dark.note: Zero illumination scenario; assumes zero photovoltaic generation. Reverse leakage is not characterized.

default_state.note: Constant indoor illumination between lighting events; this is not a measured daily light profile.
